label: Bible Study
prompt: _____ not thyself of to morrow; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.
verse: Boast not thyself of to morrow; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.
note: Don't brag about tomorrow — James says the same in his letter: 'ye know not what shall be on the morrow.'

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Thus saith the LORD; Refrain thy voice from weeping, and thine eyes from _____: for thy work shall be rewarded, saith the LORD; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy.
verse: Thus saith the LORD; Refrain thy voice from weeping, and thine eyes from tears: for thy work shall be rewarded, saith the LORD; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy.
note: To Rachel weeping for her children: refrain thine eyes from tears — they shall come again.

label: Sunday School
prompt: For the king had at sea a navy of Tharshish with the navy of Hiram: once in three years came the navy of Tharshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and _____.
verse: For the king had at sea a navy of Tharshish with the navy of Hiram: once in three years came the navy of Tharshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
note: Every three years Solomon's ships came home with gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks — a royal zoo shipment.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this _____, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.
verse: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.
note: God's foundation bears a two-sided seal: he knows his own, and his own turn from iniquity.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria, and were _____; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.
verse: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.
note: After Saul's conversion the churches had rest and were 'edified' — built up — and multiplied.
